items.sentence: Old proverbs contain valuable wisdom passed down through many generations.
The art teacher was impressed by her creative watercolor painting.
Good writers emphasize main ideas using strong examples and evidence.
The explorer made a bold decision to cross the desert.
Young athletes admire the Olympic champion for her sportsmanship.
The author used vivid sensory details to describe the forest.
The test question had multiple possible answers to consider carefully.
The ancient philosopher shared profound thoughts on virtue and justice.
The sudden severe storm caused terrible damage to coastal houses.
The school choir gave a terrific musical performance tonight in auditorium.
